notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Greenwarden of Murasa.
description:
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to Tangled Colony.
Tangled Colony dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Tangled Colony triggers, creating thirteen 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eleven times by sacrificing eleven Rats, adding {6}{U}{U}{B}{R}{R}.
Activate Greenwarden of Murasa by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Tangled Colony to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time, returning Shivan Meteor to your hand using Greenwarden of Murasa instead.
Cast Tangled Colony by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
